description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of different model configurations evaluated on the metric "Recall@10", as indicated by the chart's title. The horizontal axis displays the categorical configurations, which are labeled from left to right as "Ours", "- critiquing", "- scoring", and "- ranking", with the text tilted slightly upwards. The vertical axis represents the value for the Recall@10 metric on a linear scale that begins at 0.1 rather than zero. The vertical axis ranges from 0.1 to 0.4, with numeric tick labels at 0.1, 0.2, and 0.4, indicating a regular interval of 0.1; however, the label for 0.3 is obscured by a solid grey rectangle placed directly over the axis line. Horizontal grid lines extend across the chart from the 0.2 tick and the obscured 0.3 position. The chart contains four vertical bars corresponding to each category, which are not sorted by height. The first bar, labeled "Ours", is visually emphasized in orange and is the tallest in the chart, reaching an approximate value of 0.36. The remaining three bars are colored blue. The "- critiquing" bar has an approximate value of 0.29, the "- scoring" bar is the shortest with a value of approximately 0.17, and the "- ranking" bar has a value of approximately 0.23.
